provenance.frames: 120 rendered RGB-D frames from the 2026-08-21 mapping bench (scrum/20260821/perception/bench_mapping.md); NOT re-rendered
provenance.detector: google/owlv2-base-patch16-ensemble fp16, box threshold 0.10, 37-term open vocabulary; signal is the PER-QUERY logit column, not the argmax label
provenance.split: by CLASS. corpus rows 10-13 are in EVAL and were never in FIT.
provenance.does_not_prove: Every number here was measured in a world where three detectors score 0/69 person recall against 127-145/156 on real photographs (SYNTHESIS.md 2). Provisional. Re-earn after the world work.

operating_point_provenance.fitted_on: the FIT split only (6 present classes, 8 absent classes)
operating_point_provenance.rule: maximise FIT-present admits subject to ZERO FIT-absent admits; ties broken toward the more conservative (higher) threshold
